note: Which control makes which sound. Read top to bottom: the first rule a pressed control matches wins. A rule may name a CSS selector the control must match, a label pattern (its aria-label, else its text, else its title), a route pattern (the address after #), and on: click (the default) or change. cue null means silent on purpose. The cues themselves (which file, how loud) are in cue-map.json. Tag a control on the page with ?sounddebug, then Export to rewrite this file.
